decision.reason: The v0.2.0 package is source/hash aligned and schema-valid, but it is not a resumable v0.2.1 checkpoint: pipeline/prompt/schema provenance is incomplete or mismatched, unit-level author/auditor identities are absent, review evidence conflicts with audit summaries, and content-grounded practice quality is not closed.
decision.next_action: Create a new v0.2.1 fingerprinted build for these six units from the existing raw/source inputs; preserve the old package read-only; author/checkpoint 01-03 with the content-grounded practice contract; record distinct author and independent auditor IDs; re-run the selected visual/formula review and validation; then re-audit every practice item before any import or promotion. Do not resume or mutate portable-v0.2.0.

package_level.fingerprint_note: The old fingerprint is internally the v0.2.0 build fingerprint and is not evidence of v0.2.1 resumability. A new build_id must include the v0.2.1 pipeline, prompt, schema and current inventory inputs.
package_level.source_hash_alignment: observed aligned for all six source reports and review-plan source_hash values; this does not close the build-version mismatch
package_level.known_deferred_gate: No explicit v0.2.1 content-grounded practice-quality result exists for these units. Existing schema/independent-audit claims are insufficient to close that gate.

visible_formula_review.evidence: review-plan actual_reviewed_pages covers all four pages, but final has no structured formulas; 04-quality-audit says actual_reviewed_pages was empty/not finalization-authorizing, so evidence is contradictory.

practice_semantic_issue.finding: The five questions are citation-backed but mostly ask the learner to draw/design/compare a VM, sandbox boundary or decision matrix without a concrete guest state, resource budget, trace or falsifiable input/output. They are not accepted as content-grounded pass evidence.
practice_semantic_issue.next_action: Re-author each item with a complete solvable setting, observable result and aligned hint/evaluation; independently audit each item.

visible_formula_review.evidence: review-plan covers 49 selected/actual pages including all candidate pages; low-text pages 21-24 were explicitly excluded from claims. 04-quality-audit still says performance-table/chart visual review was incomplete, so the written audit and review-plan are not mutually consistent.

practice_semantic_issue.finding: The six questions are generally analytical prompts, but several leave the scenario to the learner: the C/HLL table has no fixed system, the experiment-design task has no prescribed workload or measurements, and the three deployment scenarios have no constraints. Citation presence does not make these directly answerable.
practice_semantic_issue.next_action: Rebuild with concrete system parameters/workloads and falsifiable expected observations, then perform the independent item-by-item audit.

visible_formula_review.evidence: review-plan actual_reviewed_pages covers all four pages and no hidden-warning pages are reported; final retains no structured formulas.

practice_semantic_issue.finding: All five prompts request labeling, drawing, explaining, simulating or comparing a network path, but give no concrete packet headers, queue sizes, arrival/service sequence or state transition table. A learner must invent the entire scenario before solving.
practice_semantic_issue.next_action: Supply fixed packet/queue/state inputs and observable output criteria for every item, then independently audit setting, hint, expected evidence and evaluation together.

visible_formula_review.evidence: review-plan actual_reviewed_pages covers all three candidate pages; final has no structured formulas. The written audit agrees on defensive scope but does not provide per-formula provenance.

practice_semantic_issue.finding: The five defensive questions are safer than operational attack tasks, but the trace has no concrete register/cache values or fixed secret/cache-line mapping, and the threat-model task leaves attacker capabilities and assets open. The requested result is therefore not falsifiable as written.
practice_semantic_issue.next_action: Use a bounded toy microarchitecture and explicit non-sensitive trace, with a stated expected classification/causal result; retain the defensive boundary and audit every item.

visible_formula_review.evidence: review-plan actual_reviewed_pages covers all four pages including all candidates; final has no structured formulas. 04-quality-audit nevertheless says manual visual review was not complete.

practice_semantic_issue.finding: The five prompts mention four cores, a linked-list update and named data structures, but do not specify an interleaving, timing/state trace, workload rates or concrete data. Several answers can be arbitrary designs while still matching the citation.
practice_semantic_issue.next_action: Instantiate bounded RCU timelines and workload parameters with observable safe/unsafe outcomes; independently review each item against the exact source concept.

visible_formula_review.evidence: review-plan actual_reviewed_pages covers 46 selected pages including all seven candidates; low-text pages 9 and 25 are selected but not evidence-bearing. 04-quality-audit says actual_reviewed_pages was empty/not finalization-authorizing, which conflicts with review-plan/review-validation.

practice_semantic_issue.finding: The five tasks ask for generic evaluation chains, fault matrices, I/O choices, responsibility mappings and proposal audits without a fixed fault state, device contract, output trace or evidence sample. They are useful prompts but not complete learner-solvable settings under the v0.2.1 contract.
practice_semantic_issue.next_action: Re-author with explicit fault injections, device states and expected classifications; preserve the source's implemented/proposed/unknown boundaries and independently audit each practice item.

non_promotion_note: Do not report a generic pass. Existing final/validation/YAML success is retained as an observed v0.2.0 artifact fact only; it is not approval for current v0.2.1 migration or database import.
